flows.title: Create a short link
steps: Click Create new in the left sidebar and select Shorten a link. You can also press L on your keyboard as a shortcut.
If you have a custom domain, select it, or use bit.ly from the dropdown.
Enter a custom back-half to make your link more unique, and optionally add a title to make your link easier to find later on.
Toggle the QR Code option if you want a Bitly Code for this link.
If you would like the link to expire, toggle the Link Expiration switch and set the time and date.

flows.title: Create a Bitly Page
steps: Click Create new in the top-left corner and select Page.
Claim the URL for your Bitly Page. This is the link you will use to share it, and it is case-sensitive.
Answer a quick question about your goals, then click Continue.
Select a template and click Use this template, or select Start from scratch.
Click + Add to add content, or Design to customize the design.
Reorder link buttons, YouTube videos and inline images by dragging and dropping them in the list.
Changes are saved as a draft. When you are ready for them to go live, click Publish changes.
